notes:
Summary: Procurement declined on unit economics. Primary objection = token/GPU cost math + required committed spend. Competitor (OpenAI) offered lower per-unit pricing on chat usage; internal infra team also presented an in-house batching plan.

Call notes (11/18/2025): 
- VP Product (R. Salazar) quote: 'We can’t justify the commit size while API per-token delta is still this high.'
- SE demo (Arjun) showed Dedicated baseline throughput but TCO projections were 2-3x their target for realtime chat workload.
- Security okayed SOC2 + SSO, no hard blocker there — main barrier is budget and commit length.

Sales notes / shorthand: 
- Champion: Senior ML lead left company mid-eval; new lead deprioritized project.
- Procurement: legal asked for 12-month minimum commitment; finance required break-even in <9 months.
- POC: completed small-scale reranking POC; results positive but costs scaled linearly with tokens and peak GPU hours.
- Quote: we proposed dedicated pool + prefix caching + quantized model recommendation; finance ran sensitivity and rejected.

Outcome: Closed - lost to mix of competitor pricing + internal infra optimization + no champion. Agreed to revisit next FY if headcount/budget changes.

Suggested follow-ups (internal): 
- Add to account watchlist for Q1 2027 re-engagement.
- Prepare lean-hosted offer with strict caps + burst-only dedicated add-on to test economics without large commit.
- Flag to product: consider smaller commit tier / pilot pricing for large-volume logistics customers.

Attachments: pricing-comparison PDF, fireflies transcript link, finance sensitivity spreadsheet.

use_case_summary: Primary: customer-facing chat assistant for dispatch + route optimization. Secondary: vector embeddings for similarity search across historical routes and reranking candidate routes at decision time. Requires sub-150ms tail latency for chat, steady throughput ~1200 reqs/min during peaks.
requirements_summary: Latency target: <150ms tail for chat responses
Throughput target: 1200 reqs/min peak; sustain 300 reqs/min baseline
Cost sensitivity: break-even target < $0.12 per 1k tokens equivalent on production traffic
Model preference: FP16 or 4-bit quantized Llama-family variant or compatibility with 2-step fallback to smaller model
Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to smaller model for burst; need deterministic quality guarantees
Compliance: SOC2 Type II, SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration
